text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=hosted-inference-prod severity=critical incident=PD12345 — High latency & rejected connections. Trigger: backend queue > 90%. Primary oncall: @ashley, Secondary: @raj, Manager: @mike. PD link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345
ashley: Ack. investigating. pulling traces now.
raj: just saw the page — phone was DND, sorry. Are we getting errors or timeouts?
ashley: Seeing 5xx spikes and connection rejects. 95% of recent failures are "Rejected connection" from the inference gateway. Spike started ~11:12 UTC. Trying to isolate to GPU node behavior.
alex: Could be GPU node OOM or process crash. Any pod evictions?
ashley: quick logs: ```kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=inference -o wide --show-labels``` and ```kubectl logs -l app=inference -n prod --tail=200 | grep "Rejected connection"``` - spotting OOMKilled on pod inference-7 on node gpu-7.
ashley: Mitigation plan: cordon gpu-7, scale nodepool, restart pods, fallback traffic to us-west-2 for critical routes. Kicking autoscale now.
mike: Manager escalation note: secondary didn't ack in escalation window so PD escalated to me. What's customer impact? Any external outages?
elaine (PM): Two customers (acme-corp, beta-saas) reported timeouts and our SLO alert group is firing. Need an ETA and whether we should send comms.
ashley: Executed: ```kubectl cordon gpu-7 && kubectl drain gpu-7 --ignore-daemonsets -n prod``` and ```gcloud container clusters resize cluster-prod --node-pool=gpu-pool --num-nodes=10``` to add capacity. Also reduced max batch size in config to prevent immediate OOMs.
ashley: Observability: p50 latency 120ms -> 890ms at peak -> now ~230ms. Error rate decreasing but some residual 5xx on warmup.
raj: sorry again for delay. I'll stay on until we hit stable baseline.
ashley: Can someone post the runbook and confirm PD timeline? Runbook: https://redwood.incidents/runbooks/hosted-inference-gpu-oom
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: escalation to manager @mike due to no ack from secondary after 8m. Manager page sent.
mike: OK. Keep the incident open until 10m of stable error rate. Assign RCA owners: raj + ashley.
alex: FYI, we saw an uptick in short-sequence background jobs (indexing) that may have driven batch sizes higher. I'll open a PR to throttle them.
elaine (PM): I'll draft a short customer comms once we see 15m stable.
ashley: Update: pods restarted, new nodes provisioned, batch-size patched. Error rate trending to baseline. Monitoring shows steady recovery.
ashley: Marking as in-progress -> will update in 10m. If stable for 15m we'll close PD.
ashley: Final update: recovered. Error rate back to baseline and latency normalized. Will keep incident in postmortem and draft RCA. Closing PD in 22 minutes if no regressions. :white_check_mark:
